units.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3 of Article 7.30.1, parts 5 - 7 of Article 7.30.2 (except violations relating to procurement under the state defence order, as well as violations relating to procurement for federal needs that is not part of the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret), Articles 7.32.6, 13.19.7, 15.1 and 15.14 - 15.15.16, part 20 of Article 19.5 and part 1 of Article 19.7.2 of this Code (within its powers).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.7

units.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.7

units.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budgetary sphere and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.7

units.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.7

units.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.7

units.locator: Article 23.7. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3 of Article 7.30.1, Article 13.19.7, parts 3 and 4 of Article 15.15, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 15.15.1, Article 15.15.5-1, parts 1 - 6 of Article 15.15.6, and Articles 15.15.7, 15.15.11, 15.15.14 and 15.15.15 of this Code.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.7

units.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.label: Art. 23.7.1

units.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.label: Art. 23.7.1

units.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3 of Article 7.30.1 and parts 5 - 7 of Article 7.30.2 (except violations relating to procurement under the state defence order, as well as violations relating to procurement for federal needs that is not part of the state defence order and information about which constitutes a state secret) of this Code, except the cases provided for by part 1.7 of Article 23.1 of this Code, and by Articles 7.32.6, 13.19.7, 15.1, 15.14 - 15.15.16, 15.37.1 and 15.41, part 20 of Article 19.5 and part 1 of Article 19.7.2 of this Code (within their powers).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.7.1

units.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.7.1

units.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 1) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.7.1

units.locator: Article 23.7.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Financial and Budgetary Sphere
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.7.1

units.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.text: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.label: Art. 23.7.2

units.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.label: Art. 23.7.2

units.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority providing treasury support shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 15.37.1 and 15.49 of this Code (within its powers).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.7.2

units.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 15.37.1 and 15.49 of this Code on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.7.2

units.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority providing treasury support and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.7.2

units.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.text: 2) the head of the structural division of the federal executive authority providing treasury support;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.7.2

units.locator: Article 23.7.2. Federal Executive Authority Providing Treasury Support
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority providing treasury support and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.7.2

units.locator: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support
units.text: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support
units.label: Art. 23.7.3

units.locator: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support
units.label: Art. 23.7.3

units.locator: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support
units.text: 1. Financial authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation providing treasury support shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 15.49 of this Code (within their powers).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.7.3

units.locator: Article 23.7.3. Financial Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Providing Treasury Support
units.text: 2. Heads of financial authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation providing treasury support and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 15.49 of this Code on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.7.3

units.text: Article 23.8. Customs Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.8

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.8. Customs Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.8

units.text: 1. A customs authority shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 11.27 (with respect to international road carriage of goods), Article 11.29 (with respect to international road carriage of goods), parts 1, 4 - 6, 12 and 13 of Article 12.21.1 (with respect to international road transport), part 1 of Article 12.21.2 (with respect to international road carriage of dangerous goods without a special permit), Article 12.21.5 (with respect to international road transport), parts 2 and 4 of Article 12.25, parts 1 and 3 of Article 16.1, Articles 16.2 - 16.24 and 19.7.13, and part 1 of Article 20.25 (with respect to failure to pay an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 11.27 or 11.29, part 1, 4, 5, 6, 12 or 13 of Article 12.21.1, part 1 of Article 12.21.2, Article 12.21.5, or part 2 or 4 of Article 12.25 of this Code, committed using a vehicle registered in a foreign state) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.8

units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.8

units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in customs affairs and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.8

units.text: 1.1) the head of the structural division of the federal executive authority authorised in customs affairs and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1.1 Part 2 Art. 23.8

units.text: 2) heads of regional customs directorates and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.8

units.text: 3) heads of customs offices and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.8

units.text: 4) heads of customs posts and their deputies — concerning administrative offences committed by natural persons;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.8

units.text: 5) other customs officials authorised to conduct customs control, exercise other types of state control, detect and suppress administrative offences and conduct proceedings in administrative offence cases — concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 11.27, parts 2 and 4 of Article 12.25, part 3 of Article 16.1, Articles 16.3, 16.5, 16.6, 16.8, 16.10 and 16.11, part 4 of Article 16.12, Articles 16.13 - 16.15, part 1 of Article 16.18 and part 3 of Article 16.19 of this Code committed by natural persons, in the case provided for by part 1 of Article 28.6 of this Code.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.8

units.text: Article 23.9. Export Control Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.9

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.9. Export Control Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.9

units.text: 1. Authorities authorised in the field of export control shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.20, part 4 of Article 19.4, part 2 of Article 19.5 (with respect to violations of export control legislation), and part 2 of Article 19.8 (with respect to violations of export control legislation) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.9

units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.9

units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of export control and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.9

units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of export control and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.9

units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of export control and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.9

units.text: Article 23.10. Border Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.10

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.10. Border Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.10

units.text: 1. Border authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (concerning the destruction of or damage to special information signs marking the boundaries of coastal protective strips and water protection zones of the internal sea waters and territorial sea of the Russian Federation, as well as signs installed by wildlife users or authorised state authorities for the protection, control and regulation of the use of wildlife and its habitats, and buildings and other structures belonging to those users and authorities), part 1 of Article 7.11, Articles 8.16 - 8.20, 8.33 and 8.35, part 2 of Article 8.37, Articles 8.38, 11.7 (with respect to violations of navigation rules in the waters of the Northern Sea Route), 18.1 - 18.7 and 18.14, part 2 of Article 19.4, and Article 19.12 (with respect to administrative offences involving items withdrawn from circulation) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.10

units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority in the field of security and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 2) heads of units authorised in the sphere of border protection and in the sphere of protection of marine biological resources within the structural division of the federal executive authority in the field of security, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 3) heads of directorates and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 4) heads of services and detachments and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 5) heads of state marine inspectorates, state specialised inspectorates, state zonal (district) inspectorates and specialised departments (divisions), and their deputies;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 6) senior state inspectors of the Russian Federation for state control in the sphere of protection of marine biological resources;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 7) heads of departments, commandants of border commandant's offices, heads of border control units and their deputies;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 8) heads of state local inspectorates and state inspection posts;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 9) state inspectors of the Russian Federation for state control in the sphere of protection of marine biological resources;
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 10) commanders of border ships (boats) and captains of border patrol vessels (boats);
units.label: Point 10 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 11) heads of border outposts, divisions, radio-technical posts and border posts, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 11 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 12) state local inspectors of the Russian Federation for state control in the sphere of protection of marine biological resources;
units.label: Point 12 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 13) heads of procedural activity units, their deputies, senior inquiry officers, inquiry officers, senior specialists and specialists in administrative proceedings.
units.label: Point 13 Part 2 Art. 23.10

units.text: 3. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.17 - 8.20 and part 2 of Article 19.4 of this Code shall be heard by the officials specified in items 1 - 9, 12 and 13 of part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23.10

units.text: Article 23.11. Military Commissariats
units.label: Art. 23.11

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.11. Military Commissariats
units.label: Art. 23.11

units.text: 1. Military commissariats shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 19.25, 19.38, 20.36 and 21.1 - 21.7 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.11

units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of military commissariats:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.11

units.text: 1) military commissars of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.11

units.text: 2) military commissars of municipal entities;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.11
